Slow Eats is a timer app designed to help you slow down and stay mindful during meals, fostering a healthier connection with food and supporting weight loss. With its simple functionality and clean design, Slow Eats offers a user-friendly experience that is both easy to navigate and highly effective. 

Slow Eats works in the background which means you can set your timer and then keep your phone in your pocket for the rest of the meal while it discreetly vibrates you to alert you when to eat or take a break. 

Slow Eats works with just your iPhone or you can download the Apple Watch app for an even more low-profile and seamless experience. 

Eating slowly has many possible benefits:
    ● Promotes weight loss by giving your brain more time to receive fullness signals
    ● Helps you better absorb the nutrients in your food
    ● Improves digestion
    ● Makes you feel calmer and more in control
    ● Increases your enjoyment of food

Choose between three types of timers:
    ● Bite Timer: Slow down how fast you eat by creating a set pause between each bite.
    ● Meal Timer: Slow down how fast you eat by defining set eating and break windows during your meal.
    ● Seconds Timer: Create a mindful pause before you get more. Give yourself time to feel full before deciding you need more.

littlefeed is a feeding tracker for your little one, designed by new parents for new parents.
